```{python}
from pyglossary import Glossary

inp = "LS_gk.mdx"          # change if needed
out = "LS_gk.xdxf"         # or .tsv / .json
fmt_out = "xdxf"           # "tabfile" for TSV, "json" for JSON

g = Glossary()
g.read(inp, format="mdx")                     # read MDict
g.write(out, format=fmt_out, keep_html=True)  # set keep_html=False to strip tags
print("Done →", out)
```
